title: From breakfast, lunch, and dinner to the Bell-inequality tetrahedron
summary: A simple pedagogical discussion and visualization of certain Bell inequalities is presented with the help of a system involving two \textquotedblleft twins\textquotedblright, originally discussed in 2605.03104. These twins answer identically when the same `question' is posed, here exemplified with: Did you like breakfast/lunch/dinner? In analogy, for two entangled particles at distant locations, the `twin-like' quantum state is such that the same outcome for the same measurement (i.e. spin direction) is obtained.
